title: What Happens to Your Body When You Don't Sleep? Hour by Hour
short_title: What 24 hours without sleep does to your brain 😴 #shorts
description:
Stay awake for one night and your brain starts acting as if you had been drinking. Keep going, and your whole body begins to struggle. Here is what science says happens, hour by hour: slower reactions, microsleeps, the brain's night-time cleaning, hunger hormones, emotions, and the risks of short sleep night after night.

{CHAPITRES}

Sources: CDC (sleep deprivation and drowsy driving: 18 and 24 hours awake compared with 0.05% and 0.10% blood alcohol; about 1 in 3 U.S. adults short on sleep; health risks of short sleep); Watson et al. (2015), AASM/SRS consensus, 7+ hours for adults; Dawson & Reid (1997), Nature; Xie et al. (2013), Science, sleep clears waste from the brain in mice; Spiegel et al. (2004), Annals of Internal Medicine, leptin and ghrelin; Yoo et al. (2007), Current Biology, amygdala reactivity after sleep loss; Gulevich, Dement & Johnson (1966), Archives of General Psychiatry, Randy Gardner's 264 hours awake.

This video is for general education only, not medical advice.
